## Concerns
- claim-1 correctly establishes that source-30 gives the numerical equality only conditionally on Conjecture 4.10.
- claim-2 correctly proves, in the same integral graded ring \(A_m\), that \(J_{v_m}=I_{w_m}\), hence their homogeneous generator numbers agree.
- claim-3 identifies the decisive failure: no supplied internal theorem with a durable locator establishes
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\qquad(m\ge1).
  \]
  Therefore the requested certificate is not established.

## Unresolved certificates
- [source-refresh] Supply the exact accepted internal theorem, all hypotheses, and immutable locator proving \(\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\) for every \(m\ge1\) in \(A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)\).
